steps.title: Analyze Build Error
steps.description: The build error log indicates an 'Incorrect package' attribute found in the AndroidManifest.xml file, stating that setting the namespace via the package attribute is no longer supported.

steps.title: Locate AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Identify the primary AndroidManifest.xml file located at `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` where the deprecated 'package' attribute needs to be removed.

steps.title: Remove Deprecated Package Attribute
steps.description: Edit the `AndroidManifest.xml` file to remove the `package="com.studyplanner.app"` attribute from the `<manifest>` root tag. The package name is now defined in `app/build.gradle` via the `namespace` property.

steps.title: Verify build.gradle Namespace
steps.description: Confirm that the `app/build.gradle` file correctly defines the application's namespace using the `namespace` property, ensuring consistency with the intended package name.

steps.title: Check Java Package Declarations
steps.description: Ensure all Java source files (e.g., MainActivity.java) correctly declare their package using `package com.studyplanner.app;` which aligns with the namespace defined in `build.gradle`.

steps.title: Clean Build Cache
steps.description: Before attempting a new build, clean the Gradle build cache to ensure that any old build artifacts that might conflict with the manifest change are removed.

steps.title: Synchronize Gradle Project
steps.description: After modifying the `AndroidManifest.xml` and verifying `build.gradle`, synchronize the Gradle project to apply the changes to the build configuration.

steps.title: Building Study Planner
steps.description: Initiate the build process for the Study Planner application to generate the debug APK after applying the necessary fixes to the manifest.
